name: NVP (North-East Village Pulse) Calypso Tent
short_desc: Community-led cultural movement, nurturing talent & preserving heritage through calypso, music, performance, and community activity.
description:
Northeast Village Pulse (NVP) is a community-led cultural movement rooted in Beaulieu and the surrounding communities of Northeast St. George’s. We aim to rebuild a culture of participation, mentorship, discipline, and community pride through calypso, music, performance, and community activity.

The Northeast was once one of the strongest forces in Grenada’s calypso tent tradition — known for talented performers, organized productions, and a deep sense of community spirit. NVP seeks to restore that energy while building new opportunities for the next generation.

We believe culture grows best when creativity is supported by structure, teamwork, consistency, and respect for the craft. Through events, mentorship, productions, and partnerships, we aim to create a lasting cultural platform for both the community and the wider Grenadian audience.

name: Island Nights

description:
Join us for an intimate celebration of familiar Caribbean flavour, presented through a refined contemporary lens. 
  
Five thoughtfully crafted courses showcase the vibrant, flavorful and laid-back living that makes the Caribbean unique. The experience unfolds alongside art, music and shared conversation. A gathering that is as much about culture as it is about cuisine.

Island Nights is not just about a meal. It is a celebration of the foods we know, elevated with care and presented with pride.
  

Limited seating. Advance reservations required.
